Description: Preprocessed EEG data. Pipeline: (1) Channel locations loaded (ModGSN-HydroCel-257.sfp, Cz reference); (2) Bandpass filter 0.1-50 Hz (pop_eegfiltnew); (3) CleanLine at 60/120 Hz (bandwidth=2, tau=100, winsize=4, winstep=3); (4) Automatic channel rejection by kurtosis (threshold=2, normalized, applied twice); (5) Manual channel rejection via visual inspection; (6) Average re-reference; (7) ICA decomposition (runica, extended); (8) ICLabel classification and manual verification of flagged components (>0.8 probability); (9) ICA component removal; (10) Spherical interpolation of rejected channels from pre-rejection channel locations.
